lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-rectilinear grid of high-luminance circular clusters is present posterior to the branchial region. Blobs are spaced approximately 3-4 diameters apart in both vertical and horizontal axes, forming a structured lattice across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating a distinct checkerboard-like pattern where intersections serve as primary nodes for the highest-intensity pixels.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge is visible across the upper third of the flank, defined by a sharp intensity gradient featuring a bright highlight on the dorsal aspect and a deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible macro-mask of the dorsal fin contains approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs distributed non-uniformly, with a higher clustering density observed towards the posterior margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct high-luminance depigmented patch is visible on the posterior distal margin of the left pectoral fin, indicating an area of potential previous tissue trauma or abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin surface exhibits a significantly higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter of white spots compared to the larger, more sparse blobs characterizing the main lateral flank.
